findings.source: Scammer: Это ж надо вставать в девять утра и работать по 4 часа хотя бы. Пиздец.
findings.currentTarget: Scammer: Lazima niamke saa tisa asubuhi na kufanya kazi angalau saa 4. Balaa.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Scammer: Lazima niamke saa tatu asubuhi na kufanya kazi angalau saa 4. Balaa.
findings.objectiveReason: Swahili clock time counts morning hours from sunrise: Russian nine in the morning is saa tatu asubuhi. saa tisa asubuhi retains the Western numeral inside a Swahili time expression and changes the waking time.
